Bank Connections (Sandbox)
Test bank data permission

FlowPay uses Plaid Sandbox to access your selected test bank's account names, balances, and transactions to show cash flow and suggest bill or income matches. FlowPay stores account information, transactions, and an encrypted access token. This is test data only, not a real bank connection.

Checking permission…
Withdrawing stops new access and synchronization but does not delete existing stored test bank data or tokens. Disconnect test banks separately to remove them.
Test banks only. No real accounts.
Cash-flow starting balance
Manual balance stays unchanged until you choose a bank.

Bank Transactions (Sandbox)

Imported transactions only. Categories are saved to FlowPay cloud data; bank records remain unchanged.

Recurring income suggestions

Requires at least three similar deposits from the same payer with a consistent interval. Suggestions never automatically add income.
